'''Lowell Woods Rops Endor''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Lowell Woods]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-20486">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20486 Rops Endor], DeckTech (Lowell "Darth Melas" Woods, 7 January 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/20486/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/20486/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016201316/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20486/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lowell Woods]]
* '''Published:''' 7 January 2002 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Rops Endor''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 ROps Woods DS 2002 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck is a AT-AT smackdown deck. It smacksdown with AT-ATs.

== Original post ==

'''Rops Endor'''
* '''Author:''' Lowell "Darth Melas" Woods
* '''Published:''' January 7, 2002
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This deck is a AT-AT smackdown deck. It smacksdown with AT-ATs.

=== Strategy ===

Start with

RalOps

Raltiir

Prepared Defences

Biker scout gear

Use RalOps to pull all of your sites. Use Twi*lek's to pull your effects. Expand the game text of forest. Get your Imperials to control Raltiir (the Tempest Scouts may help with that). Start draining at Raltiir and they will be forced to come and stop them, them smack *em down

The key is not to leave Raltiir.

Please check out my page. It has a gret pic, see for yourself

Just kidding about the AT-AT*S
